candidate_sentences.text: During the financial year ended 31 December 2025, AS Tallinna Sadam Group achieved improved profitability despite a slight decline in consolidated revenue.

Total revenue decreased by 0.8% compared with the previous year to EUR 118.7 million, primarily due to a lower utilisation rate and fewer charter days for the multifunctional icebreaker Botnica in the Other segment.
Consequently, operating profit grew by 12.2% to EUR 32.7 million, and adjusted EBITDA increased by 6.4% to EUR 56.5 million, raising the adjusted EBITDA margin from 44.4% to 47.6%.

Net profit experienced even stronger growth, rising by 17.3% to EUR 22.5 million, supported by a 30% reduction in finance costs due to lower market interest rates and reduced loan volumes, although partially offset by higher dividend income tax expenses resulting from an increased tax rate.

Capital investments totalled EUR 33.2 million for the year, representing a 14.4% decrease from the prior period, with major projects including the completion of the new multifunctional quay at Paldiski South Harbour and infrastructure preparations for future shore power installations.
The Group maintained a strong financial position, reducing net debt by 15.5% to EUR 141.7 million while preserving an equity-to-assets ratio of 61%.
